content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Identify the main organs of the digestive system
Describe the functions of each digestive organ
Understand the difference between mechanical and chemical digestion
Explain the role of accessory organs

breaks down food into small, soluble molecules that can be absorbed into the blood. It consists of a long tube (the alimentary canal) and several accessory organs that aid digestion. Food passes through the system, being progressively broken down.
